# swift-starter

> A Living Repository engineered with the Open Agentic Engineering Framework (OAEF).

## Core Governance & Architecture
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical working contract and rules for all autonomous AI agents and engineers.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Synchronized rules mirror for Claude Code.
- [docs/HARNESSES.md](docs/HARNESSES.md): Verified agent harness compatibility matrix (Tier 1–3, August 2026), harness skill mirrors and Agent Skills conformance.
- [bin/oaef](bin/oaef): Portable CLI — `doctor` (conformance), `lint`, `audit` (quality gate), `clean-code`, `ponytail debt`, `ponytail audit`, `skills audit`, `skills route "<prompt>"`, `skills sync-mirrors`, `adopt`, `upgrade`, `sync`, `metrics`.
- [docs/MANIFESTO.md](docs/MANIFESTO.md): Dual-audience charter covering business ROI and technical architecture.
- [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md): Context routing table for token-efficient task navigation.

## Agent Skills (13)
- [.agents/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md): Simplicity ladder, anti-AI-slop, root-cause fixes.
- [.agents/skills/nullable-types/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/nullable-types/SKILL.md): Strict null-safety and guard clause patterns.
- [.agents/skills/architecture-audit/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/architecture-audit/SKILL.md): Module decoupling, boundaries and sizing bounds.
- [.agents/skills/screen-builder/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/screen-builder/SKILL.md): Vertical feature and screen construction.
- [.agents/skills/component-author/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/component-author/SKILL.md): Reusable component and UI authoring.
- [.agents/skills/responsive-layout/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/responsive-layout/SKILL.md): Adaptive layouts across breakpoints and form factors.
- [.agents/skills/ui-preview/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/ui-preview/SKILL.md): Isolated component previews and rapid feedback.
- [.agents/skills/fix-layout-issues/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/fix-layout-issues/SKILL.md): Layout and rendering error debugging.
- [.agents/skills/test-generator/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/test-generator/SKILL.md): High-coverage unit, integration and branch tests.
- [.agents/skills/collect-coverage/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/collect-coverage/SKILL.md): Native coverage extraction and LCOV auditing.
- [.agents/skills/run-static-analysis/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/run-static-analysis/SKILL.md): Strict static analysis with zero warnings.
- [.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md): Pre-PR review and quality gate verification.
- [.agents/skills/conformance-audit/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/conformance-audit/SKILL.md): Repository structure, skills and mirror conformance.

## Standards & Specifications
- [docs/standards/coding_patterns.md](docs/standards/coding_patterns.md): Coding conventions and Clean Sizing limits.
- [docs/standards/clean_code.md](docs/standards/clean_code.md): Zero-tolerance clean code rules (naming, DI, nullability, resilience, allocation).
- [docs/standards/solid.md](docs/standards/solid.md): SOLID principles, substitutability and dependency inversion.
- [docs/standards/review.md](docs/standards/review.md): Pull-request review severity taxonomy and cascade remediation.
- [docs/standards/analytics_and_telemetry.md](docs/standards/analytics_and_telemetry.md): Analytics provider abstraction, consent gate and PII sanitization.
- [docs/standards/governance_checks.md](docs/standards/governance_checks.md): Normative catalog of `CC-*`, `SK-*` and `PT-01` governance checks.
- [docs/standards/testing.md](docs/standards/testing.md): Automated testing and branch coverage guidelines.
- [docs/standards/logging.md](docs/standards/logging.md): Logging standards.
- [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md): Design system tokens and architectural boundaries.
- [docs/adr/](docs/adr/): Architecture Decision Records.
- [docs/bdd/](docs/bdd/): Executable BDD Gherkin specifications.

## Quality Gates & Living Memory
- [docs/wiki/metrics/baseline.json](docs/wiki/metrics/baseline.json): Machine-readable mathematical quality gate thresholds.
- [docs/wiki/memory/handoff.md](docs/wiki/memory/handoff.md): Active inter-session memory ledger.
- [docs/wiki/memory/adoption.md](docs/wiki/memory/adoption.md): Adoption Debt Ledger generated by `oaef adopt` / `oaef upgrade`.
- [docs/wiki/log.md](docs/wiki/log.md): Append-only historical project logbook.
- [.agents/skills/](.agents/skills/): Canonical skill catalog plus per-harness mirrors rebuilt by `oaef skills sync-mirrors`.
